blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Vision--language agents generate descriptions, decisions, and instructions that may be reused by users, downstream agents, and automated workflows, creating a need for provenance mechanisms that support content authenticity and post-deployment auditing without unnecessarily degrading response quality. We present a risk-aware semantic watermarking framework that combines predictive uncertainty with a zero-shot multimodal relevance-risk proxy to allocate watermark strength during decoding. A single risk penalty $λ$ exposes a continuous operating frontier, allowing deployment-time selection of a detection--quality trade-off without model retraining. At a selected operating point, mean watermark strength is reduced by approximately 59.4\% relative to fixed-strength watermarking, while perplexity change falls from 0.3634 to 0.1689 and clean/paraphrased ROC-AUC reaches 0.9552/0.9459. A matched-strength analysis shows that this advantage reflects the allocation policy rather than lower average intervention: at comparable mean strength, risk-constrained allocation achieves substantially higher ROC-AUC than fixed, entropy-only, and criticality-only policies, identifying it as detection-efficient rather than quality-dominant. We further show that threshold calibration on finite samples produces substantial false-positive-rate drift, motivating calibration variance reporting as standard practice for auditable provenance.
blocks.zh: 视觉语言代理生成用户、下游代理和自动工作流程可能重复使用的说明、决定和指示,从而需要来源机制,支持内容真实性和部署后审计,而不会不必要地降低反应质量。 我们提出了一个意识到风险的语义水标记框架,该框架将预测不确定性与零镜头多模式相关性风险代用结合起来,以便在解码过程中分配水标记强度。 单一的风险罚款(美元)暴露出一个持续运作的前沿,允许部署时间选择检测质量的取舍而不进行模式再培训。 在选定的操作点,与固定强度水分标记相比,平均水分标记强度减少约59.4×××;而复杂度变化从0.3634降到0.1689;清洁/参数ROC-AUC达到0.9552/0.9459. 相匹配的强度分析显示,这一优势反映了分配政策,而不是较低的平均干预:在可比的平均强度下,风险受限分配比固定的、仅限演算和关键度的政策要高得多,认定其为检测效率高,而不是质量主导。 我们进一步表明,有限样本的阈值校正会产生大量虚假-正率漂移,促使校正差异报告成为可审计出处的标准做法。

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 导言

blocks.en: Vision–language agents are increasingly used to interpret images, answer visual questions, generate descriptions, and support decisions in interactive systems. Their outputs may be copied into reports, consumed by downstream agents, or treated as evidence in operational workflows. These uses create a need for mechanisms that help determine whether an output originated from an authorized model and whether it has been modified after generation.
blocks.zh: 视觉-语言代理越来越多地被用来解释图像,回答视觉问题,生成描述,并支持互动系统中的决策. 其产出可复制成报告,由下游代理人消耗,或在业务工作流程中作为证据处理。 这些用途产生了一种机制的需要,有助于确定某项产出是否源于授权的模型,以及是否在生成后进行了修改.

blocks.en: Statistical watermarking provides a widely used provenance mechanism. During decoding, a watermarking procedure modifies the token distribution according to a secret rule, and a detector then evaluates whether the resulting response contains statistical evidence of the watermark. This supports provenance verification, content authenticity, auditing, and incident investigation without requiring model retraining. However, watermarking introduces a security–quality trade-off: stronger perturbations generally improve detection, but they can also alter word choice, likelihood, fluency, and task-relevant content. Existing schemes apply a fixed watermark strength to every token decision, which is reasonable for open-ended text where a changed token is usually one plausible continuation among many. It is a poor fit for vision–language agents, whose responses may contain visually grounded objects, attributes, spatial relations, and action recommendations: modifying a token that expresses a critical visual relation may be far more harmful than modifying a stylistic or redundant one, yet a uniform-strength policy treats both decisions identically.
blocks.zh: 统计水标记提供了广泛使用的来源机制。 在解码过程中,一个水印程序根据一条秘密规则修改了符号分布,然后一个探测器评价由此产生的反应是否包含水印的统计证据. 这支持来源核查、内容真实性、审计和事件调查,而不需要模式再培训。 然而,水标记引入了一种安全-质量权衡:更强的扰动一般能改善检测,但也可以改变字词的选择、可能性、流利度和与任务相关的内容。 现行办法对每一项象征性决定都使用固定的水印强度,对于开放式案文来说,这是合理的,因为改变的标志通常是许多标志中的合理延续。 它不适合视觉-语言代理商,其反应可能包含视基对象、属性、空间关系和行动建议:修改表达重要视觉关系的标志可能比修改形而上学或多余的标志更有害,但统一强度的政策对两种决定一视同仁。

blocks.en: A small number of recent methods have begun to address this limitation by adapting watermark strength at decoding time. Entropy-based schemes increase watermark pressure when the model’s predictive distribution is dispersed and reduce it when the distribution is concentrated, which allows the watermark to exploit positions where the model has more freedom. Vision–language watermarking extends this idea to multimodal generation. These approaches are promising, but they share two limitations. First, they base allocation on generation uncertainty alone, without any signal about whether the current decision is semantically important to the response or grounded in the input image. Second, they are typically evaluated at a single default configuration, so it is unclear whether reported gains reflect the allocation policy or simply a lower average intervention.
blocks.zh: 最近有少数方法开始通过在解码时间调整水印强度来解决这一限制. 基于Entropy的图案在模型的预测分布分散时会增加水印压力,在分布集中时会减少水印压力,这使得水印能够利用模型具有更大自由度的位置. 远景-语言水标记将这一想法延伸到多式联运。 这些办法很有希望,但它们有两个共同的限制。 首先,它们仅以生成不确定性为基础进行分配,而没有任何迹象表明目前的决定对反应具有重大意义,或是基于输入图像。 第二,它们通常在一个单一的默认配置中加以评价,因此不清楚所报告的收益是反映分配政策,还是仅仅是较低的平均干预。

blocks.en: This paper studies risk-aware allocation of watermark strength during vision–language-agent decoding. At each step, the proposed method combines two signals: predictive uncertainty, represented by normalized token-distribution entropy, and a zero-shot multimodal relevance-risk proxy derived from image-conditioned and language-context representations. Watermark strength is increased when the model has greater freedom among plausible tokens, and reduced when the current probability mass is concentrated on tokens the proxy considers relevant to the visual or linguistic context. The resulting policy is parameterized by a single risk penalty λ \lambda , which controls a continuous family of allocation behaviors from near-fixed watermarking to strongly attenuated watermarking while holding the model, partition mechanism, and detector fixed. The proxy is deliberately treated as an operational risk signal rather than a calibrated estimate of semantic importance; the paper evaluates it empirically rather than assuming it is correct.
blocks.zh: 本文研究了在视觉-语言-剂解码过程中对水印强度的风险意识分配。 在每个步骤上,拟议方法结合了两个信号:预测不确定性,以正态的符号分配 en为代表,以及从图像条件化和语言文字表达中衍生出来的零镜头多式关联风险代用. 当模型在可能信物中具有更大的自由度时,水印的强度会增加,当当前概率质量集中在被代理人认为与视觉或语言上下文相关的信物时,水印的强度会降低. 由此而来的政策由单一的风险罚 QQ\lambda 参数化,它控制着一个连续的家族分配行为,从近固定的水标记到在固定模式,分区机制,和探测器的同时强烈减弱水标记. 该代词被刻意视为操作性风险信号,而不是对语义重要性的校准估计;论文从经验角度评价它,而不是假设它是正确的.

blocks.en: Our evaluation is designed to separate two questions that are often conflated in adaptive-watermarking work: whether a method improves the detection–quality trade-off at its default configuration, and whether it improves that trade-off through the allocation policy rather than through lower average intervention. To address the second question we introduce a matched-strength analysis that compares methods at comparable mean watermark strength, isolating the effect of where the watermark budget is spent from the effect of how much of it is spent. We also examine deployment realism: because a detector threshold must be calibrated on finite unwatermarked samples, we characterize how much the empirical false-positive rate drifts across calibration splits, and we argue that calibration variance should be reported as standard practice for auditable provenance systems. In summary, this paper makes three contributions:
blocks.zh: 我们的评价旨在区分两个问题,这些问题往往被混入适应-水标记工作:一种方法是否在默认配置上改进检测-质量权衡,以及它是否通过分配政策而不是通过较低的平均干预来改进这种权衡。 为了解决第二个问题,我们进行了匹配的强度分析,以可比平均水印强度比较方法,将水印预算支出地点的影响与花费多少的影响隔离开来。 我们还研究部署现实主义:因为探测器阈值必须在有限的无水标记样品上校准,所以我们确定经验性假阳性率在校准分裂中漂移了多少,我们主张校准差异应报告为可审计出处系统的标准做法。 简而言之,本文件有三项贡献:

blocks.en: • We formulate adaptive VLA watermarking as a detection–quality allocation problem parameterized by a single risk penalty λ \lambda , give an explicit implementation-level definition of the multimodal relevance-risk proxy, and derive the strength-allocation rule from a local detection-benefit versus risk objective. • We evaluate fixed-strength, entropy-only, criticality-only, and joint risk-constrained strategies under a common model, detector, prompt configuration, and 1,000-instance AMBER evaluation set, and we introduce a matched-strength analysis that separates gains attributable to the allocation policy from gains attributable to lower average intervention. • We characterize the calibration behavior of the detector across repeated held-out splits and argue that finite-sample false-positive drift should be reported as standard practice for auditable provenance systems.
blocks.zh: • 支助 我们制定适应性VLA水标记,作为检测-质量分配问题参数,以单一风险惩罚\\\ lambda为参数,对多式联运相关性-风险代用给出明确的执行层面定义,并从当地检测-效益相对于风险目标得出力量分配规则。 我们在一个共同的模型、探测器、即时配置和1 000英寸AMBER评价套下,评价固定强度、仅限演算、临界度和联合风险约束战略,并采用相应的强度分析,将分配政策带来的收益与较低平均干预带来的收益区分开来。 我们把探测器的校准行为定性为反复断裂,并主张应将有限样本的假阳性漂移报告为可审计出处系统的标准做法。

blocks.en: We formulate adaptive VLA watermarking as a detection–quality allocation problem parameterized by a single risk penalty λ \lambda , give an explicit implementation-level definition of the multimodal relevance-risk proxy, and derive the strength-allocation rule from a local detection-benefit versus risk objective.
blocks.zh: 我们制定适应性VLA水标记,作为检测-质量分配问题参数,以单一的风险处罚为参数,对多式联运相关性-风险代用给出明确的执行层面定义,并从当地检测-效益与风险目标中得出力量分配规则。

blocks.en: We evaluate fixed-strength, entropy-only, criticality-only, and joint risk-constrained strategies under a common model, detector, prompt configuration, and 1,000-instance AMBER evaluation set, and we introduce a matched-strength analysis that separates gains attributable to the allocation policy from gains attributable to lower average intervention.
blocks.zh: 我们在一个共同的模型、探测器、即时配置和1 000英寸AMBER评价集下,评价固定强度、仅限演算、临界度和联合风险约束战略,并采用匹配强度分析,将分配政策带来的收益与较低平均干预带来的收益分开。

blocks.en: We characterize the calibration behavior of the detector across repeated held-out splits and argue that finite-sample false-positive drift should be reported as standard practice for auditable provenance systems.
blocks.zh: 我们把探测器的校准行为定性为反复断裂,并主张应将有限样本的假阳性漂移报告为可审计出处系统的标准做法。

blocks.en: The scope of our claims is deliberately narrow. We do not claim that risk-aware allocation dominates fixed or entropy-only watermarking on every metric. We do not claim that the zero-shot relevance proxy is a validated semantic-importance estimator. We do not claim robustness beyond the single synonym-substitution and paraphrase procedures we tested. What we do claim is that risk-aware allocation exposes a controllable and detection-efficient operating frontier for VLA provenance, that this frontier is not reachable by fixed or entropy-only policies at equal watermark budget, and that deployment requires explicit calibration management. These claims are consistent with, and complementary to, the direction explored by VLA-Mark ( Liu et al., 2025 ) ; a same-environment numerical comparison is left to future work.
blocks.zh: 我们的要求范围是故意缩小的。 我们并不声称,风险意识的分配在每一公尺上都占据着固定或只标有肽的水位。 我们并不声称零镜头相关代理是经过验证的语义-重要性估计器. 我们并不声称我们所测试的单一同义词替代和解释程序以外的强健性。 我们所声称的是,风险意识分配暴露出一个可控制、可探测、高效率的VLA出处行动前沿,这一前沿无法在同等水印预算中通过固定或仅限演算政策进入,部署需要明确的校准管理。 这些索赔符合并补充了VLA-Mark探索的方向(Liu等人,2025年);同样的环境数字比较留待未来工作处理。

blocks.en: The remainder of the paper is organized as follows. Section 2 motivates the security–trustworthiness tension. Section 3 reviews related work. Section 4 defines the threat model and design goals. Section 5 presents the risk-aware watermarking method and derives the allocation rule. Section 6 describes the experimental setup. Section 7 reports detection, quality, matched-strength, and calibration results. Sections 8 and 9 discuss implications, limitations, and responsible-use considerations.
blocks.zh: 本文的其余部分编排如下。 第2节刺激了安全-可靠性的紧张。 第3节审查有关工作。 第4节规定了威胁模型和设计目标。 第5节介绍了意识到风险的水标记方法并提出了分配规则。 第6节描述实验设置. 第7节报告了检测、质量、匹配强度和校准结果。 第8和9节讨论了影响、限制和负责任的使用考虑。

blocks.en: 2. Security and Trustworthiness Motivation
blocks.zh: 2. 安全和可信赖动机

blocks.en: The security objective of watermarking is to make generated content statistically distinguishable from unwatermarked content. A verifier with access to the detector and secret partitioning procedure should be able to estimate whether a response was produced by the marked generation process. However, the trustworthiness objective is broader. A provenance mechanism should avoid unnecessarily changing factual content, visual grounding, fluency, and user utility. These objectives can conflict because stronger watermarking usually increases the statistical signal while also increasing the likelihood of changing the generated response.
blocks.zh: 标注水的安全目标是使生成的内容在统计上与未标注的内容相区别. 使用探测器和秘密分隔程序的核查员应能估计标记生成过程是否产生了反应。 然而,可信赖性的目标是更广泛的。 来源机制应避免不必要地改变事实内容、视觉定位、流利和用户用途。 这些目标可能相互冲突,因为加强水标记通常会增加统计信号,同时也增加改变生成的反应的可能性。

blocks.en: In vision-language settings, for a visual description, some tokens may express important objects, attributes, or spatial relations, while others may be stylistic or redundant. A uniform watermark strength treats these tokens identically. A risk-aware policy instead attempts to place stronger watermark pressure where the expected semantic effect is lower.
blocks.zh: 在视觉语言设置中,对于一种视觉描述,一些符号可能表达重要对象,属性,或空间关系,而另一些则可能具有斯式或冗余性. 统一的水印强度对这些标志的处理相同. 风险意识政策试图在预期语义效应较低的地方施加更强的水印压力。

blocks.en: This perspective treats watermarking as part of an auditable deployment workflow. Detection metrics characterize provenance performance, while quality metrics characterize the potential cost of applying the provenance mechanism. It is important to note that, neither component is sufficient in isolation. A detector with excellent AUC but severe output degradation may be unsuitable for deployment, whereas a nearly invisible watermark with weak detection may provide little practical accountability. A practical consequence of this tension is that a useful provenance mechanism should expose an operating frontier rather than a single fixed configuration, so that deployment teams can choose a detection–quality point appropriate to their auditing requirements. The method developed in Section 5 is designed around this requirement.
blocks.zh: 这种观点将水标识视为可审计部署工作流程的一部分。 检测指标是出处业绩的特征,而质量指标是采用出处机制的潜在成本的特征。 必须指出,两个组成部分都不足以孤立地进行。 具有出色的AUC但输出严重退化的探测器可能不适于部署,而几乎看不见的、检测能力弱的水印可能无法提供实际问责。 这种紧张关系的一个实际后果是,一个有用的来源机制应暴露在行动前沿而不是单一的固定配置,以便部署小组能够选择一个适合其审计要求的检测质量点。 第5节制定的方法是围绕这一要求设计的。

blocks.en: 3. Related Work
blocks.zh: 3个 有关工作

blocks.en: 3.1. Statistical Text Watermarking
blocks.zh: 3.1. 统计文字水标记

blocks.en: Many text watermarking systems partition the vocabulary into green and red lists using a secret key and modify the decoding distribution to favor green-list tokens ( Kirchenbauer et al., 2023 ) . Detection then measures whether the response contains more green-list tokens than expected under unwatermarked generation. Alternative distortion-free and distribution-preserving schemes avoid explicitly biasing the token distribution ( Aaronson and Kirchner, 2024 ; Kuditipudi et al., 2023 ; Christ et al., 2024 ) , but share the same basic property: the watermark is inserted into the generated token sequence and recovered by a detector that has access to the secret rule.
blocks.zh: 许多文字水印系统使用密钥将词汇分割为绿色和红色列表,并修改解码分布,以偏好绿色列表符号(Kirchenbauer等人,2023年). 然后检测该反应是否包含比未加水标记的生成时预期的更多的绿色清单符号。 替代的无扭曲和保存分配方案避免了对象征性分配的明显偏差(Aaronson and Kirchner, 2024年;Kuditipudi等人, 2023年;Christ等人, 2024年),但具有相同的基本属性: 水印插入生成的象征序列中,由能够进入秘密规则的探测器回收.

blocks.en: These methods are attractive because they do not require model retraining and can be integrated directly into decoding. Their limitation is that a fixed watermark bias applies the same intervention to tokens with different semantic importance. Adaptive methods address this limitation by varying the partition, bias, or strength according to context, token probability, or model uncertainty ( Kirchenbauer et al., 2023 ) . This work belongs to this adaptive family and studies how allocation strength should depend on multimodal context in a vision–language agent.
blocks.zh: 这些方法具有吸引力,因为它们不需要模式再培训,可以直接融入解码. 它们的限制是固定水印的偏差对具有不同语义重要性的符号适用同样的干预. 适应性方法通过根据上下文、符号概率或模型不确定性而改变分区、偏差或强度来解决这一限制(Kirchenbauer等人,2023年)。 这项工作属于这一适应性家庭,并研究分配力量如何取决于一种视觉-语言代理商的多式联运背景。

blocks.en: 3.2. Watermarking for Vision–Language Models
blocks.zh: 3.2. 愿景-语言模式的标志

blocks.en: In a vision–language model, the image affects the language-model logits through visual conditioning. The watermark is still inserted into the generated token sequence, but the visual context provides additional information that may be used when allocating watermark strength ( Liu et al., 2025 ) . This creates an opportunity to distinguish between tokens that are likely to express image-grounded content and tokens that are less central to the response. It also introduces additional evaluation requirements. Textual fluency alone does not establish that the response remains consistent with the input image, and a watermark that changes visually grounded content may be more harmful than one that changes stylistic tokens.
blocks.zh: 在视觉-语言模型中,图像通过视觉调节影响语言-模型的日志. 水印仍然被插入到生成的符号序列中,但视觉上下文提供了在分配水印强度时可以使用的额外信息(Liu等人,2025年). 这创造了一种机会,可以区分那些可能表达基于图像的内容的标志物和对于反应不太重要的标志物. 它还提出了额外的评价要求。 单是文字流利并不能确定反应是否与输入图像一致,改变视网膜内容的水印可能比改变结构符号的水印更有害.

blocks.en: 3.3. VLA Watermarking and the VLA-Mark Baseline
blocks.zh: 3.3. 志愿军水标记和志愿军-马克基线

blocks.en: VLA-Mark is the closest prior comparison to this work because it applies watermarking to vision–language generation and uses entropy-related information to regulate the watermarking process ( Liu et al., 2025 ) . Its allocation is driven by generation uncertainty: watermark pressure is adjusted according to how concentrated or dispersed the model’s predictive distribution is. It does not incorporate a token-level multimodal relevance signal that attenuates intervention when probability mass concentrates on visually or linguistically grounded content. The present work extends this direction by introducing such a signal and by explicitly studying matched-strength operating points that separate gains attributable to the allocation policy from gains attributable to lower average intervention.
blocks.zh: VLA-Mark是之前与这项工作最接近的比较,因为它将水标记应用于视觉-语言生成,并使用与 en有关的信息来规范水标记过程(Liu等人,2025年)。 其分配由生成不确定性驱动:水印压力根据模型预测分布的集中或分散程度进行调整. 它没有包含一种象征性的多式联运相关信号,在概率质量集中于视觉或语言上的内容时,这种信号会减少干预。 目前的工作扩展了这一方向,引入了这样的信号,并明确研究了相应的业务点,将分配政策带来的收益与减少平均干预带来的收益分开。

blocks.en: Published VLA-Mark results are not treated as directly comparable numerical baselines, because differences in model checkpoints, prompt templates, decoding settings, datasets, detector thresholds, and evaluation splits can shift reported metrics substantially. Comparing against published numbers without a common environment would conflate allocation-policy effects with implementation effects, which is precisely the kind of comparison that undermines reproducible evaluation. This paper therefore focuses on controlled within-environment comparisons; a same-environment reproduction of VLA-Mark is a necessary next step, and we make our implementation and evaluation protocol explicit so that such a comparison can be run directly.

blocks.en: Accordingly, this paper focuses on controlled comparisons within a common implementation. The main question is not whether the proposed method dominates every prior system, but whether its allocation rule exposes a useful and reproducible security–quality frontier (Section 7 ), and whether that frontier is reachable by simpler allocation policies at equal watermark budget (Section 7.3 ). These questions can be answered without a cross-implementation comparison, and the answers constrain how risk-aware allocation should be used in trustworthy deployment.
blocks.zh: 因此,本文件的重点是在共同执行范围内进行有控制的比较。 主要问题不在于拟议方法是否支配了以往的每个系统,而在于其分配规则是否暴露出一个有用和可复制的安全-高质量前沿(第7节),以及该前沿是否能够通过同等水印预算的简单分配政策达到(第7.3节)。 这些问题可以在不进行交叉执行比较的情况下得到回答,答案制约着如何在可信的部署中使用风险意识分配。

blocks.en: 4. Threat Model and Design Goals
blocks.zh: 4个 威胁模式和设计目标

blocks.en: We consider a model provider that controls a vision–language generation process and inserts a secret watermark into generated responses during decoding, conditioned on both the input image and the user query. The provider also controls the corresponding detector and key-dependent vocabulary partitioning. A verifier uses the detector to assess whether a response is likely to have originated from the marked model.
blocks.zh: 我们认为,一个模型提供者可以控制一个视觉-语言生成过程,并在解码过程中在生成的响应中插入一个秘密的水印,条件是输入图像和用户查询。 提供者还控制相应的探测器和依赖密钥的词汇分区. 核查者使用探测器评估某一反应是否可能源于标记模型。

blocks.en: The primary threat is unauthorized use or misrepresentation of generated content. The watermark is intended to provide statistical provenance evidence after generation. It is not intended to prove factual correctness, safety, authorization, or privacy preservation. Transformations such as paraphrasing, synonym substitution, deletion, truncation, and adversarial rewriting may weaken token-level watermark evidence. We therefore treat transformation robustness as a separate evaluation dimension. The current experiments evaluate one synonym-substitution procedure and one paraphrase procedure. Thus, for this work, the design goals are:
blocks.zh: 主要威胁是未经授权使用或歪曲生成的内容。 水印的用意是提供生成后的统计来源证据. 它无意证明事实正确性、安全性、授权或隐私保护。 异义词,同义词替代,删除,截断,对抗性重写等变体可能削弱象征级水印证据. 因此,我们把改革的力度作为一个单独的评价层面。 目前的实验评价一种同义词替代程序和一种释义程序。 因此,这项工作的设计目标是:

Detection quality is measured with ROC-AUC, accuracy, precision, recall, and
F1. To evaluate operational behavior at a fixed decision point, accuracy,
precision, recall, and F1 are reported at selected detector thresholds, while
ROC-AUC summarizes ranking quality across all thresholds. The magnitude of the
watermark intervention is summarized by the mean token-level strength Δ t \Delta_{t} .

blocks.en:
The experiments support a narrower but more useful conclusion than uniform
superiority over existing VLA watermarking methods: risk-aware allocation
exposes a controllable operating frontier, and different allocation policies
occupy distinguishable regions of that frontier.

The results allow us to characterize which allocation policy is preferable
under different deployment requirements. A deployment that prioritizes
detection above all other considerations is best served by fixed or
criticality-only watermarking, which achieve ROC-AUC above 0.98 0.98 at mean
strength above 1.8 1.8 . A deployment that prioritizes response quality and
tolerates weaker provenance evidence is best served by entropy-only
watermarking, which achieves the strongest automatic quality metrics at the
cost of ROC-AUC 0.9065 0.9065 . A deployment that requires strong detection under a
constrained intervention budget—for example, one that must operate near a
maximum allowable perplexity increase or response-similarity floor—is best
served by risk-constrained allocation, which reaches ROC-AUC 0.9552 0.9552 at
matched mean strength where fixed, entropy-only, and criticality-only policies
reach 0.8553 0.8553 , 0.8442 0.8442 , and 0.8405 0.8405 . This last regime is the one in which
the proposed method has a concrete operational advantage, and it is the regime
in which the matched-strength analysis matters most.

blocks.en: 9. Limitations and Responsible-Use Considerations
blocks.zh: 9. 限制和负责任的使用考虑

blocks.en:
The study evaluates one primary VLA configuration (LLaVA-1.5-7B), one
image–query dataset (a 1,000-instance AMBER subset), and one prompt template.
Results may depend on the model checkpoint, prompt format, decoding policy,
image domain, and detector implementation, and additional configurations are
needed to establish generality.

Perplexity, response similarity, and CLIP are automatic proxy metrics. They
are informative about likelihood, textual agreement, and image–text alignment

grounding, user utility, or downstream task success. The study does not include
human judgments, grounded question-answering accuracy, or task-specific semantic
evaluation, and these are required before any strong semantic-preservation
claim.

The central conclusion is therefore a controllable trade-off rather than
uniform dominance. Different allocation policies occupy distinguishable
regions of the security–quality frontier: fixed and criticality-only policies
provide stronger detection at high intervention, entropy-only allocation
provides stronger automatic quality preservation with weaker detection, and
the joint strategy offers an intermediate detection-efficient operating point
that is preferable when a deployment requires strong detection under a
constrained intervention budget. Calibration behavior reinforces the
deployment framing: finite-sample threshold selection produces substantial
false-positive-rate drift across splits, so provenance systems should report
calibration variance rather than a single operating point.

blocks.en:
The results support risk-aware watermarking as a promising design direction
for trustworthy multimodal generation, while making the scope of the current
evidence explicit: the relevance-risk proxy is not yet validated as a
semantic-importance estimator, transformation robustness is established only
for the tested paraphrase and synonym-substitution procedures, and the
evaluation covers one VLA configuration and one dataset. Future work will
include a same-environment comparison with VLA-Mark, a randomized-risk control
matched for strength distribution, human and task-specific quality evaluation,
broader transformation and adaptive-attack evaluation, larger independent
calibration sets, and multiple VLA architectures and datasets.
